{{< include _generated/publications.md >}}

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById("pub-filter-input");
  var status = document.getElementById("pub-filter-status");
  if (!input) return;
  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".pub-section .pub"));
  var norm = function (s) { return s.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, ""); };
  items.forEach(function (li) { li.dataset.text = norm(li.textContent + " " + (li.closest(".pub-year-group") ? li.closest(".pub-year-group").querySelector(".pub-year").textContent : "")); });
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    var terms = norm(input.value).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var shown = 0;
    items.forEach(function (li) {
      var match = terms.every(function (t) { return li.dataset.text.indexOf(t) !== -1; });
      li.hidden = !match;
      if (match) shown++;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-year-group, .pub-section").forEach(function (g) {
      g.hidden = terms.length > 0 && !g.querySelector(".pub:not([hidden])");
    });
    status.textContent = terms.length ? shown + " of " + items.length + " entries match" : "";
  });
})();
</script>
```
